name: Omero
bio: A young Roman of Wilde's April 1900 circle, present when Wilde and Armando were together, and the subject of a running joke: Wilde had given him a false name and address for Robert Ross, so that Omero believed Ross was really called Edmondo Gosse and lived at the Savile.
bio_note: The gap existed because only Armando has his own General Index entry ('Armando (boy), 1182, 1184'); the other two appear inside the same paragraphs and are indexed nowhere. Wilde also calls him 'HOMER' (noted): the letter at printed 1181 opens 'Homer talks much - a little too much - of you.
